name: Elnathan Topping
bioAdditions: Weygant (1897) names this Elnathan Topping Jr. as father of Jerusha, wife of James Smith, and as son of Capt. Elnathan (b. 1640) (S1). This is a second independent printed source for the identification first made from his 1751 will.
openQuestionsNew: Wife Mary's surname remains unknown; check Howell 1887 and Southampton town records.

sources.citation: C. H. Weygant, The Family Record (1897; devoted to the Sackett, Weygant and Mapes families and intersecting lines), pp. 144-145, 'Smiths of Smithtown', Generations III-V
sources.supports: Elnathan Topping Jr. father of Jerusha Smith
